title: BSCF Astronomy Olympiad 2025
description: The Closing and Prize Giving Ceremony of the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025 celebrated participant excellence through the Astro Olympiad and group presentations highlighting curiosity teamwork learning and a shared passion for astronomy and discovery.
body:
The Closing and Prize Giving Ceremony of the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025 marked the successful conclusion of an inspiring three day journey filled with learning curiosity and exploration. The final day brought together participants mentors and guests to celebrate dedication teamwork and scientific enthusiasm developed throughout the camp. One of the highlights of the program was the Astro Olympiad which challenged participants to apply their astronomical knowledge problem solving skills and critical thinking in a competitive yet friendly environment. Alongside this group presentations showcased creativity collaboration and a deeper understanding of cosmic concepts.

Throughout AstroCamp 2025 participants demonstrated a strong passion for astronomy and a growing interest in STEM disciplines. Champions were awarded certificates and medals by honorable guests acknowledging their commitment and outstanding performance. The presence of distinguished representatives from government academic scientific and professional institutions added inspiration and encouragement for young learners to pursue science and discovery. The ceremony reflected values of unity knowledge sharing and mutual support creating lasting memories for all involved. As the camp concluded it left participants motivated to continue exploring the universe strengthening their skills and contributing to the future of astronomy and scientific innovation across the country

title: Astronomy Session on Black Holes
description: The 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025 featured a Black Holes Insight Session by Professor Saleh Hasan Naqib, Vice-Chancellor of Rajshahi University. Participants engaged actively, exploring questions and ideas about the universe’s most mysterious phenomena.
body: On the third day of the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025, participants attended a Black Holes Insight Session led by Professor Saleh Hasan Naqib, Vice-Chancellor of Rajshahi University and Camp Adviser. The session provided a clear and engaging overview of black holes, exploring their formation, properties, and significance in the cosmos. Professor Naqib’s explanations were designed to inspire curiosity and deepen understanding among young astronomy enthusiasts. Following the presentation, a dynamic Q&A segment allowed participants to ask questions, discuss concepts, and share ideas about one of the universe’s most mysterious phenomena. The interactive discussion encouraged critical thinking, curiosity, and collaborative learning, making complex astronomical concepts accessible and exciting. The session successfully combined knowledge, engagement, and inspiration, leaving participants motivated to continue exploring space and developing their understanding of astronomy, while fostering a passion for science and discovery in a supportive and educational environment.

The day truly reflected curiosity in action, where learning met imagination, reinforcing the spirit of exploration and discovery that defined the overall camp experience.

title: Astrophotography Session
description: During the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025, an inspiring astrophotography session by Zubuyer Kaolin captivated participants through stunning night sky images from across Bangladesh, blending astronomy with art, storytelling, curiosity, and imagination.
body: One of the most captivating moments of the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025 was the astrophotography session conducted by Zubuyer Kaolin, a passionate astro photographer and science communicator. Through an impressive collection of night sky photographs captured from different parts of Bangladesh, he brought the universe closer to the audience. Participants were fascinated by the stories behind each image, learning about the patience, dedication, and creativity involved in capturing the cosmos. His presentation transformed astronomy into a blend of science, art, and imagination, making complex ideas accessible and engaging. The hall was filled with awe, curiosity, laughter, and inspiration throughout the session. This experience encouraged participants to see the night sky not only as a subject of scientific study but also as a source of creativity and wonder, truly reflecting a journey through the lens where stars met stories.

title: Digital Literacy and Communication
description: As part of the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, a session on Digital Literacy, Professional Identity, and Communication was held at Novotheatre, Rajshahi. Hosted by Niloy Saha Nil, participants learned to build digital presence, improve communication, and develop a professional identity for future success.
body: As part of the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, an engaging session on Digital Literacy, Professional Identity, and Communication was conducted at Novotheatre, Rajshahi. The session was hosted by Niloy Saha Nil, CEO of Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum (BSCF), who guided participants on the importance of building a strong digital presence and effective professional communication. Attendees explored strategies to enhance their online profiles, develop a professional identity, and communicate clearly and confidently in academic and professional settings. The interactive session included discussions, examples, and practical tips for personal branding, digital etiquette, and career readiness. Participants actively engaged with the content, reflecting on their own skills and identifying areas for growth. The session successfully empowered young STEM leaders to navigate the modern professional world, equipping them with essential digital and communication skills, enhancing confidence, and preparing them for leadership roles in the future.

title: Future STEM Leaders Programme Launch
description: The BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1 began with a successful launch at Rajshahi Novotheatre. Distinguished academics, researchers, and industry experts inspired participants, while partners including She-STEM, LightCastle Partners, and Novotheatre supported this initiative to empower the next generation of STEM leaders.
body: The BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1 officially began with a successful launch at Rajshahi Novotheatre, marking the start of an exciting journey to nurture and empower the next generation of STEM leaders. The event featured speeches from distinguished academics and researchers of the country, sharing insights, inspiration, and guidance for young participants. The Chief Guest was Professor Dr Robiul Islam Sarker, Director (Student Welfare) of Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology, while Special Guests included Professor Dr Sajjad Bokul, Professor Dr Ekram Hossain, Dr Habibur Rahman, Oishi Jyoti, and senior consultants Omar Farhan Khan and Nazmul Kabir Al-Mehedi from LightCastle Partners. The ceremony was supported by She-STEM, LightCastle Partners Limited, and Novotheatre, whose collaboration ensured the event’s success. The launch celebrated innovation, inclusivity, and leadership, motivating participants to actively engage, explore STEM fields, and develop skills that will shape a brighter and more empowered future.

title: Future STEM Leaders Program
description: The STEM Leadership Closing Ceremony concluded the Future STEM Leaders Program organized by Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum in collaboration with She-STEM and Rajshahi Novotheatre. Held on 13 November, it celebrated a month-long STEM training journey for students from the University of Rajshahi and Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology, encouraging women’s participation in STEM.
body:
The Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum (BSCF) Future STEM Leaders Program was successfully organized, marking the completion of a remarkable month-long journey. The closing ceremony of the program was held on 13 November at the Multipurpose Hall of Rajshahi Novotheatre.
A total of 30 female students and 6 male students from the University of Rajshahi and Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET) participated in the initiative. Throughout October, a series of sessions were conducted at Rajshahi Novotheatre, covering Human Resource Management, Research Methodology, Basics of Telescopes, and Innovation. Various theoretical and hands-on sessions were also arranged to encourage women's participation in science education.
During the program, participants engaged in multiple modules including Telescope Innovation, Research Paper Writing, Digital Identity, and Professional Development. Faculty members from the University of Rajshahi and technical experts from Novotheatre served as trainers in these sessions.

The program was supervised by
Professor Dr. Raihana Shams Islam, Department of Physics, University of Rajshahi
Professor Dr. Ekram Hossain, Department of Philosophy, University of Rajshahi
Professor Dr. Habibur Rahman, Associate Professor, Department of Folklore & Social Development Studies, University of Rajshahi
Oishi Jyoti, Assistant Professor, ECE Department, RUET
Md. Ebadat Hossain, Deputy Director, Rajshahi Novotheatre

Niloy Saha, CEO, BSCF

At the closing and award ceremony, the Deputy Commissioner of Rajshahi, Afia Akhter, attended as the Chief Guest.
Professor Dr. Raihana Shams Islam served as the Graduation Speaker.
Special Guests included Professor Dr. Md. Mozammel Hossain Bokul, Omar Farhan Khan, Senior Business Consultant at LightCastle Partners, and Nazmul Kabir Al Mehmud.
The program was jointly organized by BSCF, She-STEM, and Rajshahi Novotheatre

title: Heritage Hiking 2026
description: From exploration to excellence, BSCF Heritage Hiking 2026 brought youth together to uncover Rajshahi’s history, culminating in an inspiring research presentation and grand finale.
body:
Exploring roots through every step. 

The journey into heritage successfully concluded with the Closing & Prize Giving Ceremony of Heritage Hiking 26, organized by the Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum (BSCF) in collaboration with the BSCF Youth Network. Centered around the Varendra Research Museum and nearby historical landmarks, this week-long initiative brought enthusiastic youth together to explore, document, and share Rajshahi’s rich, untold stories. 

The program kicked off with an inspiring opening ceremony graced by Md. Aslam Reza, Deputy Librarian of Varendra Research Museum, alongside Niloy Saha Nill, CEO of BSCF. Throughout the immersive week, participants hiked across Rajshahi, collected valuable data, created meaningful content, and engaged in deep research to uncover the region's cultural identity and history. 

The grand finale began with welcome speeches from Redwan Ahmed, Convener of Heritage Hiking, and Talha Zubayer, Co-Convener of Heritage Hiking. The ceremony was chaired by Niloy Saha Nill and honored by Dr. Kazi M. Mostafizur Rahman, Director of Varendra Research Museum, as Chief Guest. Alongside Special Guests Md. Aslam Reza and Abul Kalam Muhammad Azad (Staff Correspondent, Rajshahi of Prothom Alo), the event welcomed Nafis Raihan Pial (CMO of Chorcha) and filmmaker Rahi Abdullah, who evaluated the presentations as members of the jury board.

At the end of this inspiring journey of research and storytelling, Team Shekor Jatra emerged as the Champion. Echoes of Varendra secured the position of 1st Runner-Up, while Team Chander Hashuli and Team Bagha Legacy jointly claimed the 2nd Runner-Up spot. More than just a hiking experience, Heritage Hiking 26 became a powerful journey of discovering history, identity, and culture through leadership, creativity, and collective youth effort.

title: Introduction to Human Resource Management
description: As part of the Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, a session on Introduction to Human Resource Management was hosted by Dr Ekram Hossain. Participants explored leadership, teamwork, and the human aspects of organizational growth under the SheSTEM and BSCF banner.
body: As part of the Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, an inspiring Introduction to Human Resource Management Session was conducted to broaden participants’ understanding beyond technical STEM knowledge. The session was hosted by Dr Ekram Hossain, who shared valuable insights into leadership, teamwork, communication, and the human side of organizational development. Participants learned how effective human resource practices contribute to sustainable growth, collaboration, and innovation within organizations. The discussion emphasized empathy, people management, and strategic thinking as essential skills for future leaders. Organized under the proud banner of SheSTEM and BSCF, the session encouraged participants to view leadership as a balance between technical expertise and human understanding. Through engaging examples and thoughtful discussion, the session empowered young STEM leaders to think holistically, preparing them to lead with empathy, responsibility, and innovation across diverse professional fields.

title: Science Education Policy Panel Discussion
description: On the closing day of the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025, IID and Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum jointly organized a panel discussion on science education policy and practice in Bangladesh, engaging educators, policymakers, and young participants in meaningful dialogue.
body:
On the closing day of the 2nd BSCF Astronomy Camp 2025 organized by Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum, a panel discussion was jointly arranged by IID and BSCF focusing on Science Education Policy and Practice in the Context of Bangladesh. The session was moderated by Mahfuz Mishu, Editor of International Affairs at Jamuna Television.

The panel brought together diverse voices, including Professor Dr Raihana Shams Islam from the Department of Physics at the University of Rajshahi; Shama Obaed, Organizing Secretary of Faridpur Division of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party; Samanta Sharmeen, Senior Joint Convener of the National Citizen Party; and Nurul Islam Bulbul, Central Committee Member of Bangladesh Jamaat e Islami.

Young activist Umama Fatima, Rezual Karim from Rajbari Government High School, Saeed Ahmed, Chief Executive of IID, and Camp Chief Samin Yasar Saad also shared insights. The discussion highlighted existing challenges, policy gaps, and future possibilities of science education in Bangladesh. Political representatives expressed commitment to strengthening science education nationwide. The event concluded at the Kazi Nazrul Islam Auditorium of the University of Rajshahi, leaving a strong positive impact on young participants and inspiring them toward scientific thinking, civic awareness, and informed engagement.

title: Bonna 2024
description: বিএসসিএফ পরিবার দৃঢ় অঙ্গীকারবদ্ধ ছিলো,আপনাদের পাঠানো সহায়তা বন্যায় ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত মানুষদের কাছে পৌছে দিতে।
body:
বিএসসিএফ পরিবার দৃঢ় অঙ্গীকারবদ্ধ ছিলো,আপনাদের পাঠানো সহায়তা বন্যায় ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত মানুষদের কাছে পৌছে দিতে।

আপনাদের সকলের সম্মিলিত সেই অর্থ ফেনী জেলার একটি পরিবারের পুনর্বাসনে ব্যায় করেছি আমরা। সংগত কারনেই সেই পরিবারের পরিচয় প্রকাশ করছি না আমরা। পরিবারটি বন্যায় যেমন তাদের ঘরবাড়ি হারিয়েছে তেমনি একমাত্র উপার্জনক্ষম ব্যক্তিটিও অসুস্থ হয়ে ঢাকা মেডিকেল কলেজ ও হাসপাতালে ভর্তি। আপনাদের পাঠানো সবটুকু সহযোগিতা আমরা পৌছে দিয়েছি ঢাকা মেডিকেলে গিয়ে সেই বন্যাদূর্গত, অসুস্থ ব্যক্তির হাতে।

আপনারা যারা এই উদ্যোগে সাহায্যের হাত বাড়িয়ে দিয়েছেন, তাদের সহমর্মিতা এই পরিবারটির জন্য অনন্য আর্শীবাদ হয়ে এসেছে।

এই সংহতি আমাদেরকে আগামীতেও একসঙ্গে এগিয়ে নিয়ে যাবে, মানবতার পক্ষে দাঁড়ানোর শক্তি যোগাবে বারবার।

বি.দ্রঃ বিএসসিএফ এর ব্র্যান্ডিং পলিসি অনুযায়ী, এবং সাহায্যগ্রহণকারী ব্যক্তির অনুরোধে ব্যক্তির পরিচয় ও ছবি গোপন রাখা হলো।
rawBody:
বিএসসিএফ পরিবার দৃঢ় অঙ্গীকারবদ্ধ ছিলো,আপনাদের পাঠানো সহায়তা বন্যায় ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত মানুষদের কাছে পৌছে দিতে।

আপনাদের সকলের সম্মিলিত সেই অর্থ ফেনী জেলার একটি পরিবারের পুনর্বাসনে ব্যায় করেছি আমরা। সংগত কারনেই সেই পরিবারের পরিচয় প্রকাশ করছি না আমরা।
পরিবারটি বন্যায় যেমন তাদের ঘরবাড়ি হারিয়েছে তেমনি একমাত্র উপার্জনক্ষম ব্যক্তিটিও অসুস্থ হয়ে ঢাকা মেডিকেল কলেজ ও হাসপাতালে ভর্তি। আপনাদের পাঠানো সবটুকু সহযোগিতা আমরা পৌছে দিয়েছি ঢাকা মেডিকেলে গিয়ে সেই বন্যাদূর্গত, অসুস্থ ব্যক্তির হাতে।

আপনারা যারা এই উদ্যোগে সাহায্যের হাত বাড়িয়ে দিয়েছেন, তাদের সহমর্মিতা এই পরিবারটির জন্য অনন্য আর্শীবাদ হয়ে এসেছে।

এই সংহতি আমাদেরকে আগামীতেও একসঙ্গে এগিয়ে নিয়ে যাবে, মানবতার পক্ষে দাঁড়ানোর শক্তি যোগাবে বারবার।

বি.দ্রঃ বিএসসিএফ এর ব্র্যান্ডিং পলিসি অনুযায়ী, এবং সাহায্যগ্রহণকারী ব্যক্তির অনুরোধে ব্যক্তির পরিচয়
ও ছবি গোপন রাখা হলো।

title: Civic engagement Workshop in association with IRI
description: The IRI and BSCF Workshop on civic engagement was a collaborative effort between the International Republican Institute (IRI) and the Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum (BSCF)
body: The IRI and BSCF Workshop on civic engagement was a collaborative effort between the International Republican Institute (IRI) and the Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum (BSCF), aimed at enhancing youth participation in Bangladesh's democratic framework. Held in 2024, the workshop brought together young Bangladeshis to discuss their role in elections, civic education, and leadership development, aligning with IRI's expertise in democracy and BSCF's focus on youth empowerment

title: স্বচ্ছতা
description: Purnota Foundation team and our collaborative field partners are happy to inform you that we have began to work on 5 more tube-wells!
body:
Purnota Foundation team and our collaborative field partners are happy to inform you that we have began work on 5 more tube wells! PF-003 and PF-004 is being built in Gazipur with the help of Smile-Secret of your happiness youth foundation. PF-005 is being built in Kishoreganj with the help of তারুণ্যের আহবানেে, who also helped build the first two. Additionally,বিন্যাস ফাউন্ডেশনেশন is helping us build PF-006 in Lalmonirhaat. FinallBangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum - BSCF, Rajshahiahi is helping us build PF-007 in Rajshahi.

These tube wells are being built as a part of our initiative, Project স্বচ্ছতা, which aimed to build at least 10 tube wells for families and communities in need! Thank you to all of our partner organizations for providing us with the on field assistance, our volunteers for their hard work, and our supporters who make our goals possible!

There are still 5 days for you to contribute to this cause! While we have enough funding to build the 10 tube-well, we would like to expand to at least 15 if possible. Work is being done actively and although we wanted to finish it all within ramadan, due to unavailability of labors and ensuring quality of work, some of them will be built during next month. As we prepare to close fundraising for the project, we encourage you to capitalize on the opportunity to be part of such an initiative in the month of Ramadan. Any donation amount goes a long way for us and certainly has an impact.

title: উচ্ছ্বাস
description: কিছু হাসিমুখের আনন্দধারায় প্রাণবন্ত হোক এই সন্ধ্যা
body:
গত ছাব্বিশ রোজায় আপনাদের সকলের সস্নেহ অনুদান থেকে আহৃত অর্থে আয়োজিত 'উচ্ছ্বাস' নামক সর্বপ্রথম ইভেন্টে BSCF- রাজশাহী এক্সিকিউটিভ বোর্ড সদস্যগণ ছুটে চলে শহরের নিরন্তর জায়গায় অসহায়দের মাঝে ইফতার পৌঁছে দিতে।

তারিখ_৬ই এপ্রিল, ২০২৪, ইভেন্ট: 'উচ্ছ্বাস'-কিছু হাসিমুখের আনন্দধারায় প্রাণবন্ত হোক এই সন্ধ্যা। ইফতার বণ্টন: শতাধিক রোজাদার পথচারী।

এ কাজে আপনাদের সর্বাত্মক সহায়তায় আমরা সুন্দরভাবে সম্পন্ন করতে পেরেছি। সকলকে জানাই আন্তরিক ধন্যবাদ!

title: Introduction to Research Methodology Session
description: As part of the Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, a session on Introduction to Research Methodology was held on 30 October 2025. Hosted by Dr Habibur Rahman, participants explored research design, analytical thinking, and academic inquiry under the SheSTEM banner.
body: As part of the Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, an enlightening Introduction to Research Methodology Session was conducted on 30 October 2025. The session was hosted by Dr Habibur Rahman, Associate Professor at the University of Rajshahi, who guided participants through the fundamentals of research design, analytical thinking, and academic inquiry. Participants learned how to develop research questions, approach problems systematically, and apply critical thinking in scientific exploration. The session emphasized curiosity, precision, and ethical research practices essential for academic and professional growth. Organized under the SheSTEM banner, the discussion inspired young minds to embrace research-oriented learning. Through clear explanations and practical examples, participants gained confidence and motivation to pursue academic research, innovation, and evidence-based thinking in their future STEM journeys.

title: SheSTEM Fireside Chat
description: She-STEM Fireside Chat with BSCF concluded successfully, featuring inspiring stories from Munaf Mojib Chowdhury, Prof Dr Sabrina Naz, and Mst Rumana Afroze, moderated by Md Sahariar Hasan Jisun on STEM.
body: The She-STEM Fireside Chat, organized in association with Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum, concluded successfully with meaningful dialogue and inspiration. Esteemed speakers Munaf Mojib Chowdhury, Prof Dr Sabrina Naz, and Mst Rumana Afroze shared personal journeys, professional challenges, and lessons learned in STEM fields. The session was thoughtfully moderated by Md Sahariar Hasan Jisun, creating an open and engaging discussion. Participants gained insights into leadership, resilience, and career growth, while exploring opportunities and future possibilities for women in STEM. The conversation encouraged confidence, ambition, and continued participation in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics across academic and professional communities nationwide together today onward.

title: Corporate Mindset and Modern Workplace Session
description: An online session on Corporate Mindset and Modern Workplace was conducted under the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025. Hosted by Reashad Akhtar, participants explored professional skills, adaptability, and attitudes needed to succeed in today’s evolving corporate environment.
body: As part of the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, an insightful online session on Corporate Mindset and Modern Workplace was conducted via Google Meet. The session was hosted by Reashad Akhtar, Executive Director of Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum, who provided practical insights into modern professional expectations. Participants explored essential skills, including teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and adaptability, along with growth-oriented attitudes necessary for success in evolving workplaces. The discussion highlighted how young STEM leaders can combine technical expertise with professional mindset to excel in diverse corporate environments. The interactive session encouraged reflection, questions, and engagement, helping participants understand workplace challenges and opportunities. By the end, attendees gained a clearer perspective on how to prepare themselves for future leadership roles, adapt to changing professional landscapes, and thrive in modern organizational settings.

title: Introduction to Telescope and Observation
description: As part of the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme Cohort 1, a practical session on Introduction to Telescope and Observation was held at Novotheatre, Rajshahi. Hosted by Md Ebadat Hossian, participants gained hands-on experience, enhancing curiosity, STEM skills, and observational learning.
body: As part of the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, a practical session on Introduction to Telescope and Observation was conducted at Novotheatre, Rajshahi. The session, hosted by Md Ebadat Hossian, offered participants a hands-on opportunity to learn the basics of telescope operation, astronomical observation, and practical STEM exploration. Students engaged actively with the equipment, experimented with observational techniques, and applied theoretical knowledge from previous sessions. The interactive approach fostered curiosity, problem-solving, and collaborative learning while inspiring a deeper understanding of astronomy. Participants asked questions, shared observations, and explored celestial objects in real-time, making the session both informative and engaging. This experience enhanced practical skills, strengthened observational abilities, and encouraged critical thinking. The session successfully complemented the overall STEM Leaders Programme journey, leaving participants motivated, confident, and inspired to continue exploring astronomy and other STEM fields beyond the classroom.

title: উৎসবে সবাই
description: Bringing inclusive festive celebrations and smiles to underprivileged children through community engagement and collective youth effort.
body:
Bringing joy to approximately 50 children and creating countless smiles, "Utsobe Sobai" stood out as a beacon of inclusivity and community warmth. Organized by the BSCF Youth Network, this initiative was specifically designed to promote a more inclusive Eid celebration for underprivileged children who are often overlooked during major festivities. 

Through dedicated collective efforts, impactful engagement, and structured recreational activities, the program successfully fostered an environment of warmth and belonging. "Utsobe Sobai" underscores the core belief that sustainable social impact is rooted in shared happiness, demonstrating how strategic youth-led volunteerism can bridge emotional gaps and bring meaningful value to marginalized communities.

Participants explored the importance of equal representation in STEM fields and were inspired to overcome barriers, fostering an inclusive and empowering environment for future changemakers.
body: As part of the She-STEM Internship Programme under the BSCF Future STEM Leaders Programme 2025 Cohort 1, an inspiring session on Women in STEM was conducted by Oishi Jyoti. The session highlighted the significance of equal representation across science, technology, engineering, and mathematics, encouraging participants to break barriers and pursue excellence in their chosen fields. Oishi Jyoti shared personal insights, experiences, and strategies for overcoming challenges faced by women in STEM, emphasizing resilience, leadership, and creativity. The interactive session motivated young participants to develop confidence, ambition, and collaborative skills, while fostering an inclusive mindset essential for modern scientific and professional environments. This initiative reflects the programme’s goal of empowering young minds, nurturing leadership potential, and preparing the next generation of changemakers. Attendees left inspired, equipped with knowledge, and motivated to contribute meaningfully to STEM fields while promoting diversity and equity.

title: Youth Capacity Building Bootcamp 2025
description: Under the Manusher Jonno Foundation, five BSCF youth representatives participated in the Climate Science and Negotiation Youth Capacity Building Bootcamp 2025 in Manikganj. The bootcamp brought together young leaders and climate change activists from across the country to exchange ideas, build skills, and enhance youth engagement in environmental initiatives.
body:
Five youth representatives from the Bangladesh Socio-Cultural Forum participated in the Climate Science and Negotiation Youth Capacity Building Bootcamp 2025, organized by the Manusher Jonno Foundation. The bootcamp began on 26 October at the Human Resource Development Centre in Manikganj. BSCF’s team included Redwan Ahmed, Taiyeba Tabbassum Ahmed Rafa, Labib Ahmed, Preeti Dutta Roy, and Safiat Rahman Sifat.

The event brought together enthusiastic young leaders and climate change activists from organizations across Bangladesh, providing a platform to develop skills in climate science, negotiation, and leadership. Participants engaged in interactive sessions, workshops, and collaborative exercises designed to enhance understanding of environmental issues and strengthen youth-driven initiatives. The BSCF team actively contributed to discussions, shared experiences, and built networks with peers committed to addressing climate change. Participation in this bootcamp offered valuable learning, inspiration, and motivation, reinforcing BSCF’s commitment to empowering youth and preparing them to become future changemakers in science, climate action, and community development.
